description: Maps the hottest functions in a V8 CPU profile back to their original TypeScript source locations using source map files (.js.map). Falls back to compiled JS locations if no source map is found. Use to answer: which TypeScript file and line is the bottleneck actually coming from?

sourcemap_dir.description: Override directory to search for .map files (default: same directory as .js file)

top_n.description: Number of hottest functions to resolve (default: 10)

name: correlate_source_code
